name: orbit-hero
title: Orbit Hero
description: Hero Section block. Space hero with a live, turning WebGL Earth.
docs:
Orbit Hero — Space hero with a live, turning WebGL Earth.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep them together in components/blocx/.
It loads its fonts with next/font, so it expects a Next.js app (App Router).
Its images are not part of this package. Copy public/blocx/orbit-hero/ from https://github.com/shadcn-labs/Pin-UI/tree/main/public/blocx/orbit-hero into your own public/ folder (4 files), or change the paths at the top of the component.
